title: Curated modern-English reflexes for gap morphemes (wyrd-vewk)
notes: Hand-curated modern-English reflex(es) for English-family morphemes (OE/ON/OF/ME) that have NO modern-english reflex in their cognate cluster/descent, so their era-grid modern cell renders empty. Each row maps an etymon (language:canonical_form) to the modern-English surface form(s) it survives as, with a scholarly reference. On import these should create/link a modern-english reflex etymon into the morpheme's cluster (or add an inheritance descent edge OE/ON->modern-english) so the era-grid modern stage populates. references key: Smith EPNS = A.H. Smith, English Place-Name Elements (EPNS XXV-XXVI, 1956); Gelling&Cole = M. Gelling & A. Cole, The Landscape of Place-Names (2000); Mills = A.D. Mills, A Dictionary of British Place-Names (OUP); Watts = V. Watts, The Cambridge Dictionary of English Place-Names (2004); OED = Oxford English Dictionary; Wkt = Wiktionary (en). confidence: high = standard textbook etymology + surviving modern word/element; medium = surviving as a toponymic element or dialect word but not general modern vocabulary; none = no genuine modern-English reflex (Norman-French/ON function word that survives only inside place-names) — recorded so import can SKIP it rather than re-flag it as a gap.
